about: Policy of the size check (tools/ci/check-sizes.ps1; S0b). Globs as in docs/ownership.json. Sizes are committed blob sizes (git ls-tree -r -l). A blob is held to the first fileLimits rule whose glob matches, else defaultMaxFileBytes. A budget bounds the total size of the blobs its glob matches; its name keys its metrics (budget.<name>.bytes). A forbidden rule fails every tracked file it matches, unless one of its except globs matches too. Ownership, contract files and labels are in docs/ownership.json.

fileLimits.why: GoldenSet: a committed golden file is at most 2 MiB; larger ones live in LRM_DATA/golden
